title: Transfer of development rights from landmarks
previewText: For zoning lots existing on August 14, 2025, containing landmark buildings or other structures, where more than 50 percent of the lot area is located within the Special Midtown South Mixed Use District, the provisions of Section 77-22 (Floor Area Ratio) shall be modified to permit the distribution of floor area anywhere on the zoning lot, regardless of the district boundary.
